title: Add new wife Jasmine; husband corrects her birthday; premium goes down

customer.name: Tyler Brooks
customer.persona: Just married last month, cheerful, a bit scatterbrained with dates. Your wife Jasmine is at work, so you're calling for her.

driver_relation.say_it: my wife, we just got married

correction.how: a moment later: 'wait, no, the 21st. August 21st. She'd kill me.'

vehicle_assignment.say_it: the Elantra, that's going to be her car

operator_type.say_it: she'll drive it to work every day

advice.rep_says: A spouse should always be listed; married couples often get a slightly better rate.
If the Elantra is her daily car, list her as its primary driver.
advice.customer_decision: Jasmine is primary on the 2020 Elantra

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
You just got married and need to add your wife.
Congratulate; get the policyholder name and policy number.
Give your name and policy number.
Ask her full name and date of birth.
Jasmine Brooks; give her birthday (wrong at first, then correct it); she's 30.
talk_track.direction: Say August 12th first, then correct to the 21st a second later.

talk_track.beat: Read back the corrected date of birth. Ask license state and type, and any tickets.
Explain spouses should always be listed and married couples often rate better; ask which car she'll drive and where it's kept.
The Elantra, to work every day; same address.
Suggest listing her as primary on the Elantra. Ask when to start.
Read back: Jasmine, primary on the Elantra, effective today. Quote $149 a month, $3 less than now.
Pleasantly surprised it went down; say great.
Say they'll hear the assistant now; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.

rep: When he corrects the date, read back only the corrected one.
customer: The birthday slip should sound natural, like you genuinely mixed it up.

traps: driver_dob was corrected from 1996-08-12 to 1996-08-21: the AI must use 1996-08-21 and must not ask again.
The premium goes DOWN by $3: the AI must state $149 and must not call it an increase.
